Read today's newspaper through five things that are not the main characters

From the September 26, 2026 newspaper, this essay picks five stories where the real change is happening behind the headline: GPUs becoming financeable collateral, AI growth increasing demand for HDD materials, AI research turning its own workflow into an object of automation, soy sauce gaining a third U.S. factory, and Japanese resource development reaching mud 5,569 meters below the sea. Read together, they suggest that a trend becomes infrastructure when finance, materials, production, research loops, and logistics are redesigned around it.
